mapper.select: select distinct u.user_id as userId, u.user_name as userName from sys_user u join sys_user_post up on up.user_id = u.user_id join sys_post p on p.post_id = up.post_id join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id join sys_role_menu rm on rm.role_id = r.role_id join sys_menu m on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id join sys_user_shop us on us.user_id = u.user_id join sys_dept scope_dept on scope_dept.dept_id = us.dept_id join sys_dept target_dept on target_dept.dept_id = #{deptId} where u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and p.status = '0' and p.post_code = 'yyzj' and r.del_flag = '0' and r.status = '0' and m.status = '0' and m.perms = 'inv:stockCheck:approve' and scope_dept.del_flag = '0' and scope_dept.status = '0' and scope_dept.dept_type in ('GROUP', 'COMPANY', 'STORE', 'WAREHOUSE') and target_dept.del_flag = '0' and target_dept.status = '0' and target_dept.dept_type in ('STORE', 'WAREHOUSE') and target_dept.dept_id = #{deptId} and ( target_dept.dept_id = scope_dept.dept_id or find_in_set(scope_dept.dept_id, target_dept.ancestors) ) order by u.user_id
